method: Independently regenerate both source trees using pinned generators. Tarfile.PAX_FORMAT with identical names, complete file content and frozen mtime/mode/uid/gid and GNU-compatible Zstd CLI 1.5.7 -19. Only vary file member order. Decompress each Zstd artifact, compare its TAR SHA-256 to the source TAR, extract and verify the complete SHA-256 logical tree. These additional orderings are separate controls, never substitutes for the frozen path-ascending comparator.
verification: 12/12 compressed Zstd frames decompressed to exactly matching tar bytes; 12/12 extracted data trees match their frozen SHA-256. The original two path-ascending variants match previous physical SHA-256 controls.
strongest_negative: Tar order alone changes complete stored bytes under exactly matching logical trees. The reverse Boundary control is +170 B and could create misleading near-boundary apparent headroom if substituted; the strongest observed Shifted SHA sort is 1,178 B smaller than the frozen baseline. Neither finding changes the frozen preregistered comparator, which remains path-ascending.
decision: MAINTAIN_FROZEN_COMPARATOR; preserve same-semantics alternate Zstd-19 order as a stronger auxiliary control; do not infer BDC candidate size/whole-product result from these comparator-only measurements.
